# authwise_factor_external (Data Source)

Builds a FactorExternal config and exposes its google.protobuf.Any encoding as `any`. Makes no API calls.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `config` (String) Handed to the endpoint verbatim on every call. `config` as a JSON object.
- `endpoint_name` (String) tenants/{t}/endpoints/{e}. The endpoint's own auth (kit#373) is what the factor service knows kit by.

### Read-Only

- `any` (String) protojson-encoded google.protobuf.Any (includes `@type`); reference this from Any-typed resource attributes.
